question: Two contestants run a 3-kilometre race along a circular course of length 300 metres. If their speeds are in the ratio of 4:3, how often and where would the winner pass the other? (The initial start-off is not counted as passing.)

options.C: Twice; at a distance of 225 metres from the starting point
options.D: Twice; once at 75 metres and again at 225 metres from the starting point

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
